llm.summary: The AI complex has a new, non-fundamental shock: Nvidia's board has opened an investigation into Jensen Huang's admitted affair with an alleged Chinese spy, knocking NVDA ~5% premarket (some tallies -9%) and handing newly empowered Congressional Democrats an oversight lever. This is a governance/key-man risk layered on top of an already-deteriorating tech flow picture (Technology rotation -90, Value leading Growth by 140 points, up from 130 yesterday). The macro setup is unchanged and hawkish: after the 165K payroll beat, December rate-hike odds are above 65% and markets are frozen waiting on October CPI. Oil continues to fall on Iran diplomacy, which is simultaneously disinflationary, dollar-negative and a clean margin gift to DAL and FDX; gold is back toward $4,100 as the weak dollar offsets the hike repricing. Crucially, the physical layer of AI is validated even as the narrative layer wobbles: Constellation raised guidance on 1,000+ MW of new tech deals (+4.3% gap) and NRG beat by 152c with 2027 guidance initiated (+9.6% gap), explicitly refuting the data-center-moratorium panic. Housing is the soft spot — listings piling up in October while sellers refuse to cut prices, and NAR openly saying demand is waiting on lower mortgage rates that a December hike will not deliver — a direct problem for MAS. DXCM gapped -6% on its print and is the book's weakest link. The regime reading hardened again toward Stagflation (32.8, +14.1) with Goldilocks collapsing to 17.6, which is precisely the environment the insurance/healthcare/defensive-value book is built for.

market_thesis.short_term: Index-level chop with a widening quality gap. The Nvidia governance story is an unforecastable, idiosyncratic hit to the single most crowded position in global equities, and it lands while Tech flows are already at -90 and CPI is 24-48 hours away. Expect de-grossing in the narrative/multiple-driven AI names (NVDA, neoclouds, AI software) while the contracted physical layer — power (CEG, NRG), semicap (AMAT +4.2%), grid hardware — holds up because its cash flows were just confirmed. Falling crude caps the headline CPI impulse and is the one thing that could soften the December hike case; if CPI comes in hot anyway, duration-sensitive names (MAS, housing, gold) get hit harder than the insurers benefit. Value's lead widened to 140 points, which says the rotation is still working rather than pausing.
market_thesis.medium_term: Stagflation at 32.8 with a +14.1 trend against Goldilocks at 17.6 is the operative signal for the next several months: a labour market too strong to permit easing, prices sticky enough that the Fed is debating hikes, and a China that is exporting deflation in goods and energy while running a record trade surplus. That combination caps multiple expansion for long-duration growth and sustains capital rotation into Health Care (97), Staples (97), Real Estate (92), Materials (88) and Financials (85). Inside AI, the bifurcation sharpens into 'contracted electrons and tools' versus 'storytelling and credit' — Constellation's and NRG's raises versus CoreWeave's 'doom cycle' neocloud credit narrative is that split in one morning. The Huang episode accelerates a second-order theme: AI leadership is now a political and national-security variable, not just an execution variable, which raises the risk premium on US-China-exposed semis and invites export-control and oversight headlines through 2027.
market_thesis.long_term: The binding constraint on AI remains power, land, permits and political consent, and today's utility prints are the proof: 1,000+ MW of incremental tech contracts flowing straight into raised guidance. Over years that favours regulated and merchant generation, nuclear, gas, copper and grid hardware over fabless narrative. Simultaneously, supply chains keep duplicating under tariffs, rare-earth leverage and export controls (truce extended only two months, Section 301 still live), embedding a permanently higher capex baseline and a higher inflation floor — reshoring public attention is up 87% versus its 28-day base, meaning the public is only now internalising a three-year-old capex cycle. Market plumbing is also mutating: the NYSE settling tokenized stocks on Avalanche is the first genuinely institutional on-chain settlement rail and starts a decade-long migration of post-trade infrastructure. On the household side, affordability — housing, retirement, healthcare premiums — is becoming the dominant political and consumption variable, entrenching value retail, generics/distribution, insurance and experiences at the expense of undifferentiated discretionary.

short_term: Investors are treating AI exposure as a governance and political-risk question for the first time, not just a demand question — the Huang probe is being priced as key-man risk plus regulatory exposure rather than as a demand signal.
Capital is rotating out of the narrative layer of AI and into the contracted, cash-generating layer: utilities with signed data-center MW are being bought on the same morning the chip leader is sold.

Households are postponing housing decisions outright — October listings piled up while sellers refused to cut prices, a standoff that resolves only through time or lower rates, neither of which arrives before December.
Falling pump and jet fuel prices are quietly restoring discretionary budget for travel and goods delivery even as wage-driven inflation worries persist.

Retail attention is concentrating in affordability and self-directed finance queries (Robinhood, stablecoins, bitcoin price), while crypto holders de-risk — $1.28B of Bitcoin ETF outflows into a possible hike.
Diners are being lured back by food quality rather than price promotion, a sign that value fatigue has set in at the low end of restaurant spending.
long_term: Security is being redefined as supply-chain and leadership security: who runs a critical company, where its chips are made, and whose grid powers it now carry equity-valuation consequences.
Energy demand is being re-anchored to compute rather than to industrial output or weather, converting utilities from bond proxies into contracted growth assets.

Knowledge and productivity spending is migrating from headcount to agentic software, with a nascent counter-trend of trust and control concerns as multi-agent 'teamwork' creates novel corporate failure modes.
Health behaviour is shifting toward continuous measurement and metabolic management — GLP-1 adjacency now extends into supplements and nutrition, widening the addressable market beyond pharma.

Housing scarcity is turning into a political entitlement issue (retirement and shelter framed as an 'affordability crisis'), which over years means policy risk for landlords and subsidy tailwinds for builders and renovation.
Market structure is migrating on-chain in the back office first: tokenized settlement at the NYSE normalises blockchain rails for mainstream equity ownership rather than for speculation.
